input.question: Fetch the public JSON document at https://cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=2109295512424009991&token=a . It is X's embed endpoint, readable by anyone over plain HTTPS with no login or API key (a GET returns application/json). Its field text holds one tweet. Answer with the single Ethereum contract address written in that text field. If the document cannot be fetched or names no address, answer 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000.

definitions.source: the syndication URL given, fetched directly; x.com itself is not needed
definitions.address: the 0x-prefixed 40-hex-digit string in the text field, as written
definitions.purpose: a read probe for Marginalia: can the panel read a tweet through this mirror and extract an address

_check.note: PROBE (0.5 IMD): can the panel read a tweet via X's syndication mirror and extract the address in it?
